records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.figure_queue#1
records.source: The panel combines a thumbnail strip, forward/back controls, a position label, and a zoomable full-resolution view. Every arriving figure is written to a temporary PNG. Full-resolution ``QPixmap`` objects use a least-recently-used cache, limited by the ``ram_cap`` entry count (100 by default). Evicted entries reload their PNG on demand, while thumbnails stay in memory. Clearing the queue or destroying its owner removes the temporary directory.
records.context: The panel combines a thumbnail strip, forward/back controls, a position label, and a zoomable full-resolution view. Every arriving figure is written to a temporary PNG. Full-resolution ``QPixmap`` objects use a least-recently-used cache, limited by the ``ram_cap`` entry count (100 by default). Evicted entries reload their PNG on demand, while thumbnails stay in memory. Clearing the work list or destroying its owner removes the temporary directory.
records.translation: 该面板组合了缩略图条、前进/后退控件、位置标签和可缩放的全分辨率视图。每个新到达的图都写入临时 PNG。全分辨率 ``QPixmap`` 对象使用按最久未使用顺序淘汰条目的缓存，条目数量受 ``ram_cap`` 限制（默认 100）。被淘汰的条目会按需重新加载其 PNG，而缩略图保留在内存中。清空队列或销毁其所有者时会删除临时目录。

records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.cell_montage_view#2
records.source: Image reads run through :class:`spacr.qt.job_runner.JobRunner` and only the GUI-thread completion handler updates widgets. The montage cap limits the selected objects and defaults to :data:`spacr.cell_montage.MAX_OBJECTS` (2,000). Converting image arrays to ``QPixmap`` occurs on the GUI thread; image loading and crop selection occur in the worker.

records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.loading_screen#1
records.source: The application shows this cover while constructing its window. With eager preloading, :class:`spacr.qt.app._PipelinePreloader` imports pipeline modules on a worker thread and reports progress through a GUI-thread timer. The default on-demand policy ends the loading phase without importing those modules. The host then closes the cover or starts its photomosaic animation, according to the startup preferences.
records.context: The application shows this cover while constructing its window. With eager preloading, :class:`spacr.qt.app._PipelinePreloader` imports workflow modules on a background execution unit and reports progress through a main GUI execution path timer. The default on-demand policy ends the loading phase without importing those modules. The host then closes the cover or starts its photomosaic animation, according to the startup preferences.
records.translation: 应用程序构建窗口时会显示此遮罩。启用提前预加载时，:class:`spacr.qt.app._PipelinePreloader` 在工作线程中导入处理流程模块，并通过 GUI 线程的定时器报告进度。默认的按需策略会在不导入这些模块的情况下结束加载阶段。随后，宿主窗口会根据启动偏好设置关闭遮罩或开始照片马赛克动画。

records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.loading_screen.replay_startup_animation#1
records.source: Help > Show startup animation. The black container with the logo comes back over the window, holds for two seconds and blows away as it does at startup. It plays even when Preferences > Appearance > Animation > Startup animation is off; under Preferences > Appearance > Accessibility > Reduce motion the logo holds and then cross-fades away in one second. A click or a key skips it. The window's size, state and keyboard focus are left as they were.
